T8_short_rung.note: xr_core fills the gap in 2028 at its 2027 price (R = deposit - gap). 'extra' = what the missing part really costs on 2 Jan 2028 minus that. The second line removes a year's interest, leaving only the re-pricing from 2027 yield moves.

T1_joint_storm.design: Jan 2028 deposit = $150k x f, f = min(1, exp(sig*(rho*m + sqrt(1-rho^2)*e))), m = 2027 stocks + yield move to Jan 2028 (standardised); rho also sets the stock-yield correlation in every month (gens.lognormal rho). sig 0.35 base (1-in-20 bad year: deposit ~$84k), 0.50 sensitivity. 'fixed' = deposit $150k on the same paths.

T5_implied_ratio.note: The 2031 lock is a Courtroom recommendation (28 Oct), NOT adopted in V25. Reported with and without.

T2_T3_holdback_and_remeasure.design: Same paths for every column. hold-back = coupon gap projected at 2 Jan 2028 yields + $7,500, bought in an IBTM-like Treasury maturing Dec 2032 before the floor and VT (bottom keeps A14's $3,700 cut). re-measure = bottom deducts the gap projected at Jan 2031 yields (less what the hold-back will pay) instead of $3,700. Base plans: V25 (no lock, no cushion) and the champion (lock + rule G). Worlds: house rho 0; joint storm rho 0.8 with the linked deposit (sig 0.35); storms.

T4_survivorship_haircut.design: Equity median 7.5% less 0.6pt (6.9%) and less 2.0pt (5.5%), vol unchanged; house and storm worlds; history = raw Shiller US paths with the same haircut subtracted from every month.
history_world_figures_resting_on_US_only: M1b: 0 broken promises in 1,756 historical starts; closest call 1928-29 start ($8,400 V25 / $3,100 champion above the bottom)
M1b/M6: top reached 84% (V25) and 97% (champion) in history; 'odds 5:1 (history)' at the V25 top
M7 history rows: rivals break a promise 22-36% (history column), lock-late median gift $305k, 60/40 Laura 2042 $285k
M7 sequence-risk share (stocks beat bonds in failing 60/40 paths), history and bootstrap_raw
M8: the January 1923 start (stocks ~7% a year for 15 years, 60/40 bounces 1937 and 1938)
Not equity-dependent, so survivorship does not apply: M1 price of certainty (US 10-year yields), M3 build stress (GS10 moves)

T7_deposit_x_yields.design: Yield move to 1 Jan 2027 fixed (0/-1/-2pt), later moves random (house rho 0); V25 with and without L-10's $10k coverage test (trap).
